svg.title: Sketch: where Krusgraph is heading
svg.desc: A hand-drawn sketch. A dashed boundary marks your Fabric tenant, where your data stays. You sign in with Entra. The Krusgraph app has three panes. Your estate: bronze done, silver done with keys 6 of 6, gold missing, model missing, catalog missing, comparing desired with actual. The mascots suggest: “You have no gold for orders.” with the buttons Build gold + model, Add a key check and Show why; one tap is a dry run. An arrow leads to the Plan: 4 gold views, a model on gold, 12 tests, the rest defaults, and an Approve button, which leads to a pull request in Fabric Git. One sign-in and one approval; everything else is a default. Behind the scenes: Find, Ask, Build, Approve, Run, Use, Improve. Find, Build and Improve are rules; Ask, Run and Use are where a model proposes; Approve is you. Data rows are read only inside Fabric.
svg.text: Your Fabric tenant · your data stays here
data rows are read only inside Fabric
